message:
Running command: cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cat > /usr/local/bin/ruby <<"SH"
#!/bin/sh
export LD_PRELOAD="/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libasan.so.8${LD_PRELOAD:+:$LD_PRELOAD}"
export ASAN_OPTIONS="detect_leaks=0${ASAN_OPTIONS:+:$ASAN_OPTIONS}"
exec /usr/bin/ruby "$@"
SH
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/ruby
ln -sf /usr/local/bin/ruby /usr/local/bin/ruby3.2
which ruby
ruby -I/gt/_work/src/lib -rox -e "begin; Ox.parse(\"<a>a\"); rescue Exception => e; warn e.message; end" 2>&1 | head -30'
